#pawpaw #hiking #plants 

We take a hike for many hours looking for Pawpaws and finally we found a few! 

Thanks to John taking us on this amazing hike. 
Also a thanks to Marjorie for editing this video. 

Follow me on instagram: Blakesnaturelife
